newsitem.title: USA: U.S. wheat weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. wheat weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.

text.p: USDA wheat export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Sales of 641,700 metric tons (MT) were 16 percent below the previous week and equaled the 4-week average. Major Increases were recorded for unknown destinations (116,400 MT), Iraq (115,000 MT), the Philippines (50,600 MT), Japan (47,400 MT), and Yemen (35,000 MT).

Exports of 616,000 MT were 7 percent lower than the prior week and 1 percent less than the 4-week average. The primary recipients were Japan (82,400 MT), the Philippines (76,000 MT), Egypt (63,800 MT), Morocco (50,200 MT), Pakistan (50,000 MT), and Tunisia (43,800 MT).
